paragraphs.text: The Eliterate Colony is a Vodalian merfolk enclave in a deep trench in the Voda Sea . It was founded by outcast artists, musicians, and poets escaping the tyranny of Empress Galina , and is located 60 leagues from the Vodalian capital.

Near the end of Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria , Yawgmoth took the form of a huge deathcloud that killed everything it touched, which included most of Vodalia . Galina was one of the many casualties, ending her thousand-year reign. The planeswalker Bo Levar sacrificed his life to prevent the cloud from reaching the Eliterate commune set up in a deep trench to escape from Vodalian society. Following a brief period of chaos, the reigns of government were taken up by the Emperor Omen , a moderate captain of the Imperial army - in reality, the Eliterate actor Destry . "Omen" rebuilt New Vodalia into a democratic, benevolent society until he was unfortunately killed by great shark - although this was a staged death using illusory magic. The Eliterates were thus instrumental in rebuilding Vodalian society before they returned to their trench to reestablish their artistic colony.
